project_type: Browser 3D game — eldoria-academy. React 19 + Vite SPA shell lazy-loading a three.js / @react-three/fiber + drei + rapier game canvas; zustand stores for UI/HUD/progression state; a mutable per-frame runtime object for high-frequency data; Web Audio.
build_system: Vite 8 + tsc project references. `npm run build` = `tsc -b && vite build`. Node ESM ("type": "module").
test_framework: Vitest 5 with jsdom; @testing-library/react for component tests. 6 existing test files: src/game/core/systems.test.ts, src/game/flight/flight.test.ts, src/game/player/animationMachine.test.ts, src/game/quests/quests.test.ts, src/game/spells/spellSystem.test.ts, src/ui/menus/menus.test.tsx.
build_command: npm run typecheck   (tsc -b)   and   npm run build   (tsc -b && vite build)
test_command: npm test   (vitest run).  Target one file with: npx vitest run <path>
verification_instructions: From the worktree root c:\Projects\Hogwarts\.worktrees\wand-broom-map, PowerShell, chain with ';'. Before editing run `npm test` once to record the green baseline (6 files). After changes the full gate is: `npm run typecheck ; npm test ; npm run lint ; npm run build` — all four must pass (design AC-12). Never run `npm run dev`. For behaviours not coverable by unit tests (3D wand orientation, SVG map render, M-key toggle, in-world pickup interaction) walk the six code-path traces in design.md §10. Remove any scratch files afterwards.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None relevant to this task. `npm run assets:characters` builds skinned-character GLBs but characterLibraryAvailable() is false in the shipped repo, so the procedural avatar path is the default and no generated asset is required.
environment_constraints: Windows + PowerShell: chain commands with ';' not '&&'. Use absolute paths rooted at c:\Projects\Hogwarts\.worktrees\wand-broom-map; relative paths risk landing in the parent workspace. Do not run the dev server. The implement-and-review loop's stop contract is fixed: the fixer/reviewer convergence loop writes verdict.json; keep writing it every iteration.
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING.md/README.md found in the worktree root; follow in-repo conventions. No new runtime dependencies (design §3 locks the stack). The map is inline SVG in a React component — not canvas, not a 3D minimap. High-frequency data stays in runtime.ts and is surfaced to React at ~10 Hz via HudSync; never trigger per-frame React re-renders.
key_patterns: Collectables (Codex, ShrineEmber in WorldItems.tsx) derive `collected` from a useProgression selector and registerInteractable({id,position,radius,verb,label,onInteract}); they return null + unregister once collected. Store mutations follow addArtifact: guard idempotency, set state, notify via useHud, emit a typed event on `events`, then save(). Pure/testable logic is extracted into plain modules (spellSystem.ts, flightMachine.ts) and unit-tested; scene/quaternion math is split into pure helpers (new wandAim.ts, mapProjection.ts, questMap.ts). The Action union in bindings.ts is an explicit string-literal union, and ACTIONS = Object.keys(DEFAULT_BINDINGS); adding an action requires editing the union, ACTION_META, and DEFAULT_BINDINGS. Overlay panels: `panel modal` + role=dialog + aria-label + CloseButton, rendered inside overlay-backdrop in GameMenus.GameOverlays, keyed off useGame overlay state.
